headlines.title: AI agents to start spending your money with Visa, Mastercard
headlines.summary: The two card giants want to stay central as AI software starts to shop for you.

headlines.title: MoneyGram Launched a Visa Card That Spends USDC. Ripple’s Former Partner Chose Circle
headlines.summary: MoneyGram just built a Visa card that spends stablecoins at any merchant, and the stablecoin it chose raises an uncomfortable question for Ripple's payments ambitions.

headlines.title: Visa Stock Rises as AI Alliance Forms, Trades 13.06% Below GF Value
headlines.summary: Visa, Mastercard and Ant International are developing shared identity standards for trusted AI purchasing agents.

headlines.title: Visa Positions Itself for the Next Wave of Stablecoin Payments
headlines.summary: Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) is expanding its data offering to blockchain-based lenders as demand for stablecoin-linked cards accelerates. Visa said it is combining its VisaNet settlement data with onchain lending infrastructure to help stablecoin card programs and fintechs obtain working capital more efficiently.

headlines.title: Why Visa’s Agentic Commerce Play Isn’t the Threat Wall Street Thinks It Is
headlines.summary: Wall Street keeps bidding Visa shares higher even as AI shopping agents threaten to reroute every transaction the network touches. The answer lies in a pattern Visa shareholders have watched play out three times before, each time with the same outcome.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
